fusion_ranked_evidence.title: South India leads India's nursing workforce as national ratio remains below WHO benchmark - The South First
fusion_ranked_evidence.snippet: # South India leads India’s nursing workforce as national ratio remains below WHO benchmark. > ***Synopsis:** Parliamentary data reveal a stark regional divide in India’s nursing workforce, with Kerala, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu accounting for nearly half of the country’s registered hospital nurses. South India has emerged as the country’s nursing powerhouse, with Kerala, Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu accounting for nearly half of India’s registered hospital nursing workforce and recording some of the country’s highest nurse-population ratios, according to data tabled in Parliament. A written reply by Union Health Minister JP Nadda in the Rajya Sabha on 21 July states that India had 46.02 lakh registered nursing personnel as of 31 December 2025, translating to a nurse-population ratio of 2.60 per 1,000 people. “As per the Indian Nursing Council (INC) records, there are 46.02 lakh nursing personnel registered in the country as on 31st December, 2025, giving a nurse to population ratio of 2.60 nurses per 1000 population,” Nadda said in response to a starred question.

fusion_ranked_evidence.title: US measles cases hit 2,318 in 2026, surpassing last year's total: CDC - ABC News - Breaking News, Latest News and Videos
fusion_ranked_evidence.snippet: # US measles cases hit 2,318 in 2026, surpassing last year's total: CDC. This marks the highest number of cases recorded since 1991. The number of confirmed measles cases in the U.S. so far this year has hit 2,318, surpassing the total reported for all last year, according to data updated Friday from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Previously, last year's total of 2,289 was the highest number of recorded measles cases in more than 30 years, CDC data shows. Sixteen of this year's total have been among international visitors to the U.S., according to the CDC. The majority of measles cases in 2026 have been confirmed among children and teenagers aged 19 and younger, according to the CDC. Meanwhile, 3% of cases are among those who have received just one dose of the measles, mumps, rubella (MMR) vaccine and 4% of cases are among those who received the recommended two doses, according to the CDC.

Some 5.3 million workers — 5% of NILFs — have dropped out because they are discouraged or they’re not even bothering to look for work. “Very roughly speaking, there are about 7 million of these men who are out of the labor force for the 25-to 54-year-olds,” said Eberstadt, whose 2016 book, “Men Without Work,” discussed the phenomenon of American men in their prime leaving the workforce.
